== English Reflections III comparison ==
The replacement explicitly targets a Jedi to determine the pool for the random combat card placement. The target card still goes to the opponent’s Used Pile. The duel cancellation, Deep Hatred search, Maul’s no-combat-card condition and Sense immunity are retained.
